primaryComponents: Auger Assembly (Power Curve® rubber auger, steel shaft, bearings)
Scraper Bar (composite or metal, bolted to housing)
Discharge Chute (high-impact plastic or steel, rotatable)
Chute Deflector (adjustable flap on discharge chute)
Wheels (large, semi-pneumatic or solid rubber tires on steel rims)
Personal Pace® Drive System (friction disc or gear-based transmission, drive belts, pulleys, clutch mechanism, axle)
Auger Drive System (drive belt, pulleys, auger clutch mechanism)
Control Cables and Linkages (for auger engage, drive engage, chute control)
operationalLogic: The internal combustion engine powers two primary functions: the Personal Pace® self-propel drive system, which moves the unit forward, and the Power Curve® auger. As the snowblower advances, the rapidly rotating rubber auger directly contacts, scoops, and simultaneously propels snow through the discharge chute. The operator uses the Quick Shoot™ joystick to mechanically adjust the chute's direction and the deflector's height, controlling the trajectory of the expelled snow.
maintenanceNodes: Engine oil level check and change
Fuel system draining and fuel stabilizer addition for storage
Auger drive belt inspection and replacement
Personal Pace® drive belt inspection and replacement
Chute rotation and deflector mechanism lubrication
Control cable tension adjustment and lubrication
Fuel filter replacement (if inline filter is present)
